## Proposal
**Use case. Why is this important?**
In some of our large-scale deployment scenarios, we need to evaluate the network bandwidth by querying the scrape target return body size.
 I wish I could submit the Merge Request to improve this functionality。
*“Nice to have” is not a good use case. :)*
comments: Yes, you could start with #7722 and add it behind the extra scrape metrics feature flag.

review_comments: Instead of having a separate `bytes` variable, could we just rely on `sl.lastScrapeSize`? Unless it's an issue to exempt empty scrapes from this metric (cc @roidelapluie).
I used `len(b)` due to following concern: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/7722#issuecomment-667658759 🤔
